coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping in his own room, keeping the room dark and quiet with the fan off.
Showering and washing, following his usual morning routine step by step.
Making and eating a flexitarian breakfast of toast, fruit and tea, then rinsing his plate.
Reviewing his written weekly budget notes and checking reminder alerts on his phone before starting study.
Setting up his desk lamp, computer and monitor and logging into the Monash online learning platform for the lockdown study day.
Attending a live online Master of Social Work lecture and taking detailed written notes.
Boiling the kettle and making a cup of tea for a short study break.
Reading course materials and drafting assignment notes on the computer, checking each reference carefully.
Cooking a simple flexitarian lunch with vegetables and rice in the rice cooker, eating it and washing up.
Sorting laundry, running the washing machine and drying clothes, checking the load against his written chore schedule.
Checking his written reminders and planning the afternoon study blocks in his notebook.
Joining an online tutorial discussion group for his social work coursework via the computer.
Making another cup of tea and eating a small snack.
Completing his assignment draft, formatting references and saving backups on his computer.
Taking a short permitted solo walk around the neighbourhood for exercise during the lockdown.
Preparing a flexitarian dinner using the induction cooker and oven, keeping the kitchen tidy as he works.
Eating dinner at the table with a cup of tea, without alcohol.
Washing the dishes, wiping the counters and putting the dried items away.
Sending detailed text messages to his family in China and looking at the photo of his family dog.
Reading quietly on his bed with a mug of tea to wind down.
Taking his evening wash, brushing his teeth and getting ready for bed.
Recording the day's cash spending against his weekly budget and setting tomorrow's reminder alarms on his phone.
Reading a book under the desk lamp as a quiet pre-sleep routine.
Sleeping, with the room kept quiet and dark for the night.
